texts.preamble: A.Anbukkarasu vs The Managing Director on 30 July, 2025 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated :30.07.2025 Coram The Honourable Mr.JUSTICE C.Kumarappan W.P.No.27800 of 2025 A.Anbukkarasu . Vs. 1.The Managing Director, Metropolitan Transport Corporation (Chennai) Limited, Pallavan Salai, Chennai - 600 002. 2.The Senior Deputy Manager (Hrd), Metropolitan Transport Corporation (Chennai) Limited, Pallavan Salai, Chennai - 600 002. 3.The Assistant Manager (Personnel), Metropolitan Transport Corporation (Chennai) Limited, Pallavan Salai, Chennai - 600 002. 4.The Branch Manager, Metropolitan Transport Corporation (Chennai) Limited, Pallavan Salai, Chennai - 600 002. . 1/5 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 06/08/2025 03:47:33 pm ) A.Anbukkarasu vs The Managing Director on 30 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144066057/ 1 Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of praying to issue a Writ of Mandamus, to direct the respondents to incl the name of the petitioner's present wife, Tmt.A.Thulasi, as the nomin further to include the name of his son, A.Mahesh Kumar, as a co-nomine the petitioner's service and pension records. For Petitioner : Mr.T.Ramkumar For Respondents : Mr.R.Balaji Standing Counsel Order
texts.facts: The instant writ petition has been filed to direct the respondents to include the name of the petitioner's wife, Tmt.A.Thulasi, as the nominee and further to include the name of his son, A.Mahesh Kumar, as a co-nominee in the petitioner's service and pension records.
